prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Original grounded medieval RPG LOW RES PIXEL ART character review board. Uniform neutral medium grey opaque backdrop. Exactly two columns: front-left full body and matching back-right full body of SAME person per row. Different rows are independent people, no interaction. Compact stocky game sprite proportions and conspicuously chunky square pixel clusters, simple 3-tone clothing, selective dark outline, small simple faces. Muted earth wool, linen and worn leather; simple medieval round/tie neck cuts. No modern lapels, suits, uniforms, medical symbols, fantasy ornament, magic, text, labels, border, scenery, agreement, payment or resolved quest. All appearance, hair, exact age, and gender where source unspecified are proposals, not narrative canon. No invented injuries or diagnoses. Native grid, palette, animation and runtime unverified. THREE rows. TOP KEWEI mature adult male finite mine-share investor, neat short grey beard, muted plum knee tunic and simple brown cloak, small CLOSED leather folio, no gold piles. MIDDLE LUOFU adult female drainage and domestic-water continuity worker, broad build dark hair with linen headwrap, dull olive dress hitched above plain boots and tan work apron, small wooden channel scraper held safely down. BOTTOM BEINA adult female sandwashing settlement resident, dark hair beneath faded blue kerchief, russet dress and grey shoulder shawl, holds EMPTY plain earthenware water jug. No drinking test, diagnosis, water proved clean by color, settlement payment or forced migration.
